clues.text: This city spreads across rolling hills at the foot of a mountain chain. More trees shade its streets than in any other big city in the land.
clues.narrowing: Rules out flat towns; puts the player in rolling hills with the densest city tree cover.

source.quote: Atlanta features a unique topography that includes rolling hills, lush greenery, and the densest urban tree coverage of any major city in the United States

clues.text: Weather here can swing fast in the cold months. Warm gulf air brings spring-like highs, then Arctic air drops the nights into the teens.
clues.narrowing: Rules out steady southern warmth; keeps swings between gulf air and Arctic air.

source.quote: Warm air from the Gulf of Mexico can bring spring-like highs while strong Arctic air masses can push lows into the teens

clues.text: Trains built this town, and trains won it the big job in 1868. That year, the state capital moved here for its fine rail links.
clues.narrowing: Shrinks the list to capitals that won the seat in 1868 through rail links.

source.quote: Due to the city's superior rail transportation network, the state capital was moved from Milledgeville to Atlanta in 1868

clues.text: This city was a chief base of the civil rights movement years ago. Martin Luther King, one of its own, led the fight for fair laws.
clues.narrowing: Nearly decisive: one capital was a chief base of the civil rights movement under King.

source.quote: it became a major organizing center of the American civil rights movement, with Martin Luther King Jr., Ralph Abernathy, and many other locals serving as prominent leaders

clues.text: The laws of Georgia are made in this city. It is the state capital, and the state's largest city too.
clues.narrowing: Confirms it: the state governor and lawmakers work in this capital city.

source.quote: Atlanta is the capital and most populous city of the U.S. state of Georgia

reveal.blurb: Atlanta began as the end stop of a state railroad, and its strong rail lines won it the state capital in 1868. Martin Luther King Jr. led the civil rights fight from here in the years that followed. Atlanta is the capital of Georgia.
